Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalated, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.

Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.

Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands‑on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and / or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

Derflan is seeking a Solutions Architect to support a large global technology organization through a high-impact consulting engagement focused on cloud architecture, performance optimization, and enterprise workload modernization. This is an onsite role based in São Paulo, Brazil. Candidates must currently live in São Paulo.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and enterprise performance optimization, supporting large-scale workloads across industries. The position focuses on designing and implementing cloud solutions, optimizing compute performance, and partnering with engineering, sales, and customer teams to drive adoption and business outcomes.

Role Description

Role Description : Solutions Architect (Cloud Infrastructure)

Employment Type

Employment Type : CLT (full-time employee with benefits)

Annual Base Salary

Annual Base Salary : BRL $450,000 – $550,000

Key Responsibilities

Customer Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Design scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures supporting enterprise workloads
  • Partner with customer executives, architects, and technical teams to drive cloud adoption
  • Provide technical guidance on complex architecture, performance, and infrastructure challenges
  • Conduct benchmarking, testing, and optimization of compute-intensive workloads
  • Lead customer engagements with defined scope, deliverables, and success criteria
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and partner teams
  • Support deployment and optimization of enterprise workloads in cloud environments
  • Ensure successful execution of technical initiatives across customer accounts

Technical Advocacy & Knowledge Sharing

  • Act as a subject matter expert in cloud infrastructure and performance optimization
  • Document architectures, best practices, and solution patterns
  • Contribute to technical content including blogs, case studies, and enablement materials
  • Deliver technical sessions, workshops, and customer-facing presentations
  • Track customer adoption and usage of cloud infrastructure solutions
  • Support pipeline development through technical engagements and workshops
  • Provide technical documentation including architecture designs and solution frameworks
  • Contribute to sales and marketing collateral supporting enterprise solutions
  • Maintain reporting and tracking within internal systems

Required Qualifications

  • Experience designing and implementing cloud architectures
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and distributed systems
  • Experience supporting enterprise customer engagements
  • Experience with performance benchmarking and workload optimization
  • Experience working at AWS (full-time or contract) is required
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • Ability to collaborate across technical, sales, and partner teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Solutions Architecture or similar roles
  • Experience with performance optimization and compute-intensive workloads
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications such as SAP, HPC, or AI / ML workloads
  • Cloud certifications (preferred)
  • Experience delivering technical content, workshops, or customer enablement
  • High-impact, customer-facing technical role
  • Collaborative environment across engineering, sales, and partner teams
  • Fast-paced, performance-driven environment with strong ownership

Why Join Us

As a Derflan consultant, you will support a global technology leader and work on complex cloud architecture initiatives that directly impact enterprise customers. This role offers strong ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge infrastructure and performance optimization projects.

Benefits at Derflan

Consultants will receive a full São Paulo, Brazil benefits package aligned to CLT employment.

Derflan is a boutique consulting firm supporting some of the world\'s most innovative organizations. We specialize in placing high-caliber professionals in impactful roles that drive measurable business results.

Position Summary

The Radiation Therapist (RTT) reports to the Radiation Therapy Lead and provides the technical portion of radiation therapy treatments within the department of Radiation Oncology. Their primary duties include the delivery of radiation treatments according to written prescriptions and treatment plans while ensuring safety in patient care through the consistent practice of departmental procedures for treatment administration. Treatment delivery includes identifying the correct patient, escorting patients to the treatment room, assisting patients onto the treatment table, positioning patients for treatment, delivering radiation from the control room and assisting the patient in exiting the treatment room.

The RTT provides and ensures an environment of caring, concern and support for patients, visitors, medical staff and co-workers on a consistent basis. They ensure the quality of treatment delivery through the complete and accurate documentation of treatment records. They also recognize deviations from prescribed treatment delivery and report all deviations to the Radiation Therapy Lead and/or Physician. Uses effective communication techniques and interpersonal skills to adequately explain the treatment‑related procedures to patients and their families while referring medical questions to appropriate personnel. The RTT observes patients for expected and unexpected reactions to treatments and communicates this to appropriate staff members. They also reinforce patient education and side‑effect management information and indicate non‑compliance to medical/nursing staff. Additionally, the RTT is able to independently perform patient simulations at the request of physicians as well as collect and document data acquired during the simulation procedure and accurately input the treatment‑related data into the EMR. The RTT assists as needed in all treatment‑related procedures, including transporting patients, reviewing charts, and ordering supplies. They demonstrate the ability to recognize standard imaging/ARGT and make the necessary adjustments to ensure high‑quality treatment. The RTT performs and documents daily and weekly QA checklist. They notify appropriate clinical team members and document findings outside the normal range of operations. The RTT participates in programs to measure and improve the quality of care within the Department and uses critical thinking to troubleshoot and often fix common quality issues. They also capture and verify patient treatment charges.

Key Performance Areas

  • Provide radiation therapy services by contributing as an essential member of the radiation oncology treatment team through provision of total quality care of each patient.
  • Communicate effectively with patients, families and other members of the radiation oncology team.
  • Respond physically, intellectually and emotionally to emergency situations, provide first aid, CPR and other patient care until a physician or nurse arrives.
  • Capable of handling stressful situations, making informed decisions and giving emotional support to patients and their families.
  • Document accurately and legibly treatment set‑ups, doses and calculations.
  • Use good judgment in regard to situations in which treatment may be held until consultation with the radiation oncologist.
  • Explain procedure to patient, means of communication during treatment and procedure to be followed if an emergency arises during treatment.
  • Reinforce advice given to patients about skin care, mouth care, diet and general welfare.
  • Provide instructional direction and/or guidance to therapists under his/her supervision in correct procedure and practice for both routine and complex tumor localization and treatment.
  • Fulfill the essential functions of a registered RTT in the clinical setting of Radiation Oncology.
  • Evaluate and assess treatment delivery components by manually performing quality assurance and quality control checks, observing monitors and scales to note divergence from expected readings, detecting equipment malfunctions and taking appropriate action.
  • Evaluate and assess daily the physiological and psychological responsiveness of each patient during delivery including providing effective patient education.
  • Maintain values congruent with the profession's code of ethics and scope of practice as well as adhering to national, institutional and/or departmental standards, policies and procedures regarding treatment delivery and patient care.
  • Comply with all Federal and State laws and regulations pertaining to patient care, patient’s rights, safety, billing, and collections. Adhere to all company and departmental policies and procedures, including IT policies and procedures and Disaster Recovery Plan.
  • Provide technical guidance to Radiation Therapist I in absence of Radiology Team Lead.

Education

  • Minimum: Graduate from an accredited School of Radiation Therapy Technology.
  • Preferred: BS Degree in Radiation Therapy Technology or other related field.

Previous Experience

  • Minimum of three (3) years active experience as a Radiation Therapist is required.

Licenses/Certifications

  • Certified as a Registered Radiation Therapy Technologist by the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists. Dual certification as a General Radiographer (ARRT) or CT Technologist is preferred.
  • Must have current CPR/BLS certifications.

Skills

  • Fluency in the English language as well as excellent oral and written communication skills is essential. Additionally, ability to communicate in Spanish is also desirable.

Travel: Rarely

Standard Work Days/Hours: Monday - Friday, 8am - 5pm

  • Sign‑On Bonus: Enjoy a $10,000 sign‑on bonus to welcome you to our team.

Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within the Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage clients to identify risks before they escalte, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.

  • Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks.   • Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.
  • Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

  • Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.
  • Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.
  • Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.
  • Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.

Hands‑on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.
  • Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.
  • Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.
